title: (RHBA-2024:0630) Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.12.11 Bug Fix update
portal_summary: Updated images that fix several bugs are now available for Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.12.11 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 from Red Hat Container Registry.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.12.11 Bug Fix update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation for IBM Z and LinuxONE|4|s390x
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation for IBM Power, little endian|4|ppc64le
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|4|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation is software-defined storage integrated with and optimized for the Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation. Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation is a highly scalable, production-grade persistent storage for stateful applications running in the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. In addition to persistent storage, Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation provisions a multi-cloud data management service with an S3-compatible API.

Bug fixes:

* Previously, object buckets were unable to provide the details to the object bucket claims (OBCs) that refer the object buckets because the object buckets that were collected through the ocs-metrics-exporter never had the OBC references in it. With this fix, the matching OBC details are added to the object buckets thus populating OBC label details for the query. (BZ#2239766)

* Previously, the Multicloud Object Gateway command for `obc regenerate` did not have the flag `app-namespace`, which is available for other object bucket claim (OBC) operations such as creation and deletion of OBC.
With this fix, the `app-namespace` flag is added to the `obc generate` command. As a result, OBC regenerates S3 credentials in all namespaces. (BZ#2246877)

All users of Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation are advised to upgrade to
these updated images, which provide these bug fixes.
